nonvacuity: Explicit independent paired family for every r >= 2, N=2r, with fixed parity outcomes, marginals 1/2, uniform bounds 1 and 2, genuine row bound 2 and N*Var tending to 8. scratch/Checks.lean independently compiles all N=4 marginal identities; reading.md and claim-checks.md check the full witness conditions, including stability across population sizes.

Take N independent fair Bernoulli exposures with y_i(0)=y_i(1)=1. The identity graph has row bound 1; comparison bounds are 1 and 2; true variance and estimator (11) both equal 4/N. Thus Condition 6 has limit 4 and every lower-tail probability is zero; all positive off-diagonal joints are 1/4 for N>=2. scratch/SequenceCheck.lean compiles the sequence construction, product moments, marginals and comparison bounds, plus a finite true-variance and estimator check. The remaining general graph and variance identities, and hence full hypothesis satisfiability, are established by the explicit calculation in claim-checks.md rather than a full Lean sequence proof.
